headline: Proposed shopping cart regulations adding Article IV to Gloucester Code Chapter 14, Offenses and Miscellaneous Provisions.
summary: The meeting covers one item: a proposed new article on shopping carts. The article would add definitions, rules on identifying carts, rules on keeping carts on premises, and enforcement.
items: CC#2026-017 (Benson): Amend GCO Ch. 14 "Offenses and Miscellaneous Provisions" by adding a new Article IV, "Shopping Cart Regulations"
Sec. 14-48 "Shopping carts to be confined to premises"
